title: Repair Bun Workspace and Lockfile
description:
Root package.json's workspaces array listed "mathematical/graph/port/directed/dag", a path that no longer exists on disk (a concurrent session's refactor removed it), which broke `bun install` for the entire repo with a "Workspace not found" error. Separately, a new bundle vcs/core (depends on @noble/hashes@^1.8.0) was added to workspaces recently but has never gone through a clean `bun install` because of the above breakage, so neither vcs/core nor @noble/hashes appear in bun.lock yet — a prior agent worked around this by manually extracting the npm tarball into node_modules, which is not a real fix.

Task: investigate what happened to mathematical/graph/port/directed/dag, find its correct current location (if any), fix the workspaces entry in root package.json, run a clean `bun install` from repo root, confirm bun.lock now contains @noble/hashes and vcs/core/@semio-tech/vcs-core entries, and run `bun nx run @semio-tech/vcs-core:test` to confirm the 34 existing tests are still green now that they resolve via the real lockfile instead of the manual tarball workaround.
summary:
Root cause found and fixed for the broken bun workspace glob; the vcs/core verification could NOT be completed because a concurrent session is actively deleting vcs/core mid-task (evidence below), which is outside this ticket's control.

WORKSPACE FIX (validated):
- root package.json's workspaces array pointed at "mathematical/graph/port/directed/dag", which no longer exists (confirmed via `git ls-tree` history: it was deleted down to a single AGENTS.md stub, now at mathematical/graph/port/directed/normal/AGENTS.md, which has no package.json anywhere under it or its siblings).
- Traced the real successor via repo-wide grep for a package.json named like the old "dag" package: found `infinite/board/port/directed/dag/package.json` (name "@semio-tech/dag-core"), a complete, unambiguous, non-conflicting workspace (has project.json, script.ts, rs/Cargo.toml + lib.rs, plugin/rs/Cargo.toml + lib.rs, prebuilt wasm pkg). Also corroborated by a concurrent worktree (.claude/worktrees/agent-afa905cc164f52ed8) mid-flight on ticket "RELOCATE-APP-LOCATED-GENERIC-ENGINE-CRATES-INTO-FRAMEWORK-SURFACE" containing the identical infinite/board/port/directed/dag layout.
- Diff applied to /Users/ueli/Documents/semio/package.json (workspaces array):
  `-    "mathematical/graph/port/directed/dag",`
  `+    "infinite/board/port/directed/dag",`
- Ran `bun install` from repo root: completed cleanly ("Resolved, downloaded and extracted [146]", "Saved lockfile", "9 packages installed", no "Workspace not found" or other fatal error). Log saved at .repo/🎫/26/07/19/REPAIR-BUN-WORKSPACE-AND-LOCKFILE/bun-install.log.
- Confirmed bun.lock now resolves the new workspace: `"infinite/board/port/directed/dag": { "name": "@semio-tech/dag-core" ... }` and `"@semio-tech/dag-core": ["@semio-tech/dag-core@workspace:infinite/board/port/directed/dag"]`.

VCS/CORE — COULD NOT VERIFY (blocked by unrelated concurrent work, not a regression from this fix):
- While this ticket was in progress, package.json's "vcs/core" workspace entry disappeared from the working tree (unstaged diff, not made by me — my only edit was the dag line above) and vcs/core's actual files became STAGED FOR DELETION in git (`git status` shows "D " for vcs/core/package.json, project.json, script.ts, js/hasher.ts, js/index.ts, js/vitest.config.ts, js/fixtures/checkpoint-undo-redo-branch.json) — i.e. another session is actively deleting/relocating vcs/core right now, mid-operation.
- Repo-wide grep for any relocated target (package.json named "@semio-tech/vcs-core", or hasher.ts / checkpoint-undo-redo-branch.json elsewhere) found nothing — the concurrent deletion has no landing spot yet, so it is genuinely mid-flight with no valid alternate target to point at.
- Consequently: bun.lock contains no @noble/hashes and no vcs/core / @semio-tech/vcs-core entries (grep confirmed both absent) — this is the CORRECT resolution of the current on-disk workspace list, not a bug in my fix.
- `bun nx run @semio-tech/vcs-core:test` fails with "NX Cannot find project '@semio-tech/vcs-core'" (log saved at .repo/🎫/26/07/19/REPAIR-BUN-WORKSPACE-AND-LOCKFILE/vcs-core-test.log) because project.json no longer exists on disk. This could not be made green — the package it would test does not currently exist in the working tree.
- Did NOT attempt to restore/recreate vcs/core files myself: per repo rules (shared tree, never fight concurrent edits, no destructive/reverting actions), reverting another session's staged deletion mid-flight would be wrong. Recommend a follow-up ticket once the concurrent vcs/core relocation settles, to re-add its workspace entry (if it lands as a new package.json) and re-run `bun install` + the vcs-core test suite.
- Stale leftover from before this churn: node_modules/@semio-tech/vcs-core is a dangling symlink to ../../vcs/core (dated Jul 1, predates this session) and node_modules/@noble/hashes still contains the previous agent's manual tarball extraction; both are now orphaned since vcs/core is not currently a workspace member. Left untouched (not the scope of this fix, and touching node_modules while a concurrent bun/git operation is mid-flight would risk more churn).

Files touched:
- /Users/ueli/Documents/semio/package.json (workspaces: mathematical/graph/port/directed/dag → infinite/board/port/directed/dag)
- /Users/ueli/Documents/semio/bun.lock (regenerated by `bun install`)
- .repo/🎫/26/07/19/REPAIR-BUN-WORKSPACE-AND-LOCKFILE/bun-install.log (new, install output)
- .repo/🎫/26/07/19/REPAIR-BUN-WORKSPACE-AND-LOCKFILE/vcs-core-test.log (new, test-run output showing the current NX failure caused by the concurrent vcs/core deletion)

Note: package.json also shows an unstaged change to animate/present/core/package.json made by another concurrent session; not touched or investigated as out of scope.
